# Feature Request: Title

## Description

One-paragraph description of the feature being requested. This should include the rationale for why this feature should be added.

## Proposed Solution

Clear description of what should happen to fulfill this request. Describe the feature in terms of its inputs and outputs.

## Alternative Solutions

If this solution is not possible, what should be done instead?

Which parts of the solution are essential, and which might be dependent on other features?

## Additional Context

Additional context may include steps to recreate a problem, screenshots, and other information to help ensure correctness of the solution.
